headlines: SPY premarket ~713.9 (-1.2%) at 14:06Z, giving back part of Monday's +4.7%; range 713.5-728
Stocktwits-shared article: NVDA slides ~5% Tuesday after Monday's ~31% Huang reinstatement pop; futures lower
Trending premarket: DELL -7.5% (#1), HPE -12.6%, AVGO -3.8%, AMBA -3.7%; INSM +14.4%, SNY +8%, KSS +8.4%
Nov flash PMI (per Stocktwits post): composite 54.6 vs 55.9, four-month low, services miss, still expanding
US GDP 2nd estimate due tomorrow 13:30 UTC; holiday-shortened week
VIX 27.5 and Fear & Greed 16.5 (extreme fear) are Stocklake's last snapshot from Nov 23 20:05Z

rumors.text: Traders now price ~95% odds of a December Fed rate HIKE (claimed in a FactSheets article shared on Stocktwits)
rumors.why: A hike instead of cuts would pressure equity multiples, especially high-beta tech

rumors.text: New rounds of tariffs / renewed China tariff posturing (vague Stocktwits chatter, no source)
rumors.why: Fresh tariffs would hit risk appetite; crowd also expects possible delays

rumors.text: NVDA 'blowback' coming as trust in Huang/US governance erodes; UK selling into US open (single opinion post)
rumors.why: Further unwinding of Monday's NVDA-led rally would drag the index

rumors.text: Bipartisan lawmakers push chip-export legislation after Huang reinstatement (carried over, still unverified)
rumors.why: Regulatory overhang on NVDA and semis

plays.reason: Premarket fade below 714 with AI hardware (DELL, HPE, AVGO, NVDA) leading lower while NVDA crowd remains extremely bullish (77)
plays.catalyst: Continued unwind of Monday's NVDA-driven rally; rate-hike chatter

plays.reason: Extreme fear readings plus holiday-week seasonality and crowd noting pros avoid holding shorts over the holiday

readings.whats_new: SPY reversed from Monday's 722.3 close to ~713.9 premarket (-1.2%) as NVDA slid ~5% and AI hardware names (DELL, HPE, AVGO) lead trending losers. New chatter centers on claimed ~95% December Fed hike odds and fresh tariff talk; the Burry and moratorium stories have dropped off. NVDA crowd cooled from 86 to 77 but is still extremely bullish.
